DCTL.description: Design Control Data (DCTL). Global steel design control settings driving frame sway classification, automatic effective length factor calculation, and the design dimension type; single global record with key = 1, all fields optional (PUT merges only the fields you send). Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. DELETE does not remove the record: it resets it to defaults (FRAMEX/FRAMEY = 'Braced Non-sway', bAUTOKF = false, DT = '3D'). LLRF shares this same underlying record, so set DCTL before using LLRF.

FRAMEX.description: Frame type in the X-direction. Case-insensitive. 'Braced Non-sway' sets the braced (non-sway) frame flag; 'Unbraced Sway' sets the unbraced (sway) frame.

FRAMEY.description: Frame type in the Y-direction. Case-insensitive. 'Braced Non-sway' sets the braced (non-sway) frame flag; 'Unbraced Sway' sets the unbraced (sway) frame.

bAUTOKF.description: Auto-calculate the effective length factor (K factor) when true.

DT.description: Design (dimension) type. Case-insensitive. Selects the analysis dimension used for design: 3D, or the XZ / YZ / XY plane.
